name: Sikkim

mcqs.q: Which national park in Sikkim holds the rare distinction of being India's first and only 'Mixed' UNESCO World Heritage Site?
mcqs.exp: Khangchendzonga National Park was inscribed in 2016 under both natural and cultural criteria.

mcqs.q: Through which amendment to the Indian Constitution did Sikkim officially become the 22nd state of the Indian Union in 1975?
mcqs.exp: The 36th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1975 made Sikkim a full-fledged 22nd state of India.

subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Sikkim.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Gangtok. Sikkim covers a geographic area of 7,096 sq km across 6 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Teesta (Lifeline of Sikkim), Rangit.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: India's first 100% organic state. Home to Mount Kangchenjunga (8,586m, India's highest peak). Joined the Indian Union via the 36th Constitutional Amendment Act 1975.

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Sikkim.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Sikkim was formally instituted on 16 May 1975. Official language(s): English, Nepali, Bhutia, Lepcha.

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Singhi Chham (Snow Lion dance), Maruni, Rechungma.

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Losoong, Pang Lhabsol, Saga Dawa.

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Sikkim.

facts.title: Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Governor is Om Prakash Mathur.

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of Sikkim is Prem Singh Tamang (Golay).

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under High Court of Sikkim (Gangtok).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Red panda | State Bird: Blood pheasant | State Flower: Noble dendrobium | State Tree: Rhododendron.

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Sikkim.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Copper, Lead, Zinc, Dolomite.

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Sikkim plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Sikkim.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Rumtek Monastery, Pemayangtse Monastery, Nathu La Pass (historic Silk Route to Tibet).

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Khangchendzonga National Park (India's ONLY Mixed World Heritage Site on UNESCO list).

subtopics.summary: Prominent welfare schemes, civic initiatives, and state honors of Sikkim.

facts.title: Key State Welfare Schemes
facts.content: Notable welfare initiatives and government programs: One Family One Job Scheme, Aama Yojana, Vatsalya Scheme.
